feature: Startup PCM gate and continuous late-picture presentation, retaining0.41 decoder/GPU path

console_evidence.user_report: MPEG2 works; H264/MPEG4 lags more than0.39; same H264 file plays well in Simple360Player
console_evidence.interpretation: Near-stream-rate decoding combined with zero presentation and growing discarded-late count identifies a real all-late-frame policy defect. Not proof that CPU decoding always reaches target.

changes.startup: Normal PCM waits until first picture is handed to renderer; bootstrap chooses earliest ready picture without an already-running audio clock
changes.presentation: Remove pre-output all-late discard; take newest due frame and coalesce older READY frames; held ownership preserved
changes.audio_lead: Break the bounded dependency only when demux waits for audio capacity and video waits for its first packet; PCM then advances until timestamped video can be reached
changes.diagnostics: Add lag_ms, late_presented, audio_preroll; existing FPS/decode/preparation/first-frame logs retained
changes.decoder_GPU: FFmpeg configuration/patches and GPU renderer/shader/colour source byte-identical to0.41. No new SIMD, quality shortcuts or decoder-frame skipping.
changes.scope: No new GPU codec decoder or transcoder; CPU decode plus three-plane GPU colour conversion/scaling retained;720p output
